story.title: Our Story
story.p1: Born from the frustration of disconnected creative industries, 3YESES emerged as a revolutionary solution to bridge the gap between talent and opportunity. We recognized that the entertainment industry was ready for a digital transformation that would democratize access to opportunities and streamline the casting process.
story.p2: Our founders, with decades of combined experience in entertainment production and talent management, envisioned a platform where creativity meets efficiency. Where actors, musicians, dancers, and production professionals could showcase their talents without geographical limitations, and where casting directors could discover the perfect talent for their projects.
story.p3: Today, 3YESES stands as the most comprehensive talent platform in the industry, continuously evolving to meet the needs of modern creative professionals while maintaining the personal touch that makes great collaborations happen.

2023.title: Foundation & Launch
2023.description: 3YESES launches with core categories: Acting, Music, and Dance. Initial beta testing with 500+ users.

2024.description1: Added Crew and Production categories. Launched mobile-responsive design and advanced search features.
2024.description2: Introduced AI-powered matching algorithms and content generation. Reached 2,000+ active users.

2025.title: Platform Evolution
2025.description: Launch of social features, video hub, and community tools. Expanding internationally with multi-language support.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: To democratize the entertainment industry by providing equal opportunities for talent discovery, fostering meaningful connections between creative professionals and project creators, and building the most inclusive and efficient talent marketplace in the world.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description: A world where every creative professional has the tools and platform they need to showcase their talents, connect with opportunities, and build successful careers in the entertainment industry, regardless of their background or location.

inclusivity.title: Inclusivity
inclusivity.description: We believe every voice deserves to be heard and every talent deserves an opportunity.

excellence.title: Excellence
